Method of Attack: Using mouse movements to detect real user interaction and avoid sandbox environments and automated virtual machines
Checking file names for alphanumeric characters to detect analysis environments
Checking local PC for apps with graphical interfaces and number of processes to detect virtual machines
Checking user's IP address against a list of IPs assigned to security companies or data centers
Checking for recently opened files to detect user activity
Deploying via three nested DLL files with malicious macro scripts in Word documents
Using mouse movement motions to brute-force an encryption key stored in the second DLL to obtain the third DLL
Attack Vector: Spam email carrying password protected ZIP file with Word documents containing malicious macros
Indicators of Compromise: Password protected ZIP file in spam email
Three Word documents with malicious macro scripts
Nested DLL files downloaded and decompressed by macros
